skill.summary: Get benchmark video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompts (TXT, DOCX, CSV, JSON, up to 500MB), say something like "...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video Benchmark.

- Generate AI videos from text prompts, with upload support for TXT, DOCX, CSV, and JSON (up to 500MB).
- Automatic cloud setup: handles NEMO_TOKEN authentication and cloud session creation.
- Supports 1080p MP4 exports and batch processing of multiple prompts.
- Credits balance, session state, and export functions accessible via simple commands.
- Accurate error messages for token, credits, file size/type, and session issues.
- Timeline viewer for previewing video, audio, and text tracks.
